classical_theorem_dependencies.Brooks_theorem: A connected graph has chromatic number at most its maximum degree unless it is complete or an odd cycle.
classical_theorem_dependencies.Gallai_low_vertex_theorem: In a k-critical graph, the subgraph induced by the degree-(k-1) vertices is a Gallai forest.
classical_theorem_dependencies.Bikov_minimal_Ramsey_degree: A minimal (3,3)-Ramsey graph with clique number three has minimum degree at least eight; the bounded specialization used here is also independently exhaustively checked.
